result.instructions: Tools for Wufoo, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Wufoo data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run wufoo_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run wufoo_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run wufoo_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. wufoo_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: wufoo_list_forms
tools.title: List forms
tools.description: List the forms the API key's user can access: name, description, hash (permanent identifier), URL title, public/private, start/end dates, entry limit, created/updated timestamps. Set includeTodayCount to add EntryCountToday. Wufoo: GET /forms.json.

includeTodayCount.description: Include EntryCountToday, the number of entries received today.

tools.name: wufoo_get_form
tools.title: Get one form
tools.description: Fetch one form's settings by hash or URL title — name, description, confirmation message, notification emails, public flag, language, start/end dates, entry limit and links. Wufoo: GET /forms/{identifier}.json.

form.description: Form identifier: its permanent hash (e.g. s1afea8b1vk0jf7) or its URL title (e.g. wufoo-api-example). See wufoo_list_forms.

tools.name: wufoo_get_form_fields
tools.title: Get form fields
tools.description: The field structure of a form: each field's Title, Type, API ID (Field###, used for filters, sorting and submissions), required flag, default value and page. Checkbox, name, address and likert fields list SubFields with their own IDs; multiple-choice, dropdown and likert fields list Choices. Admin-only fields are not returned. Wufoo: GET /forms/{identifier}/fields.json.

form.description: Form identifier: its permanent hash (e.g. s1afea8b1vk0jf7) or its URL title (e.g. wufoo-api-example). See wufoo_list_forms.

system.description: Include system metadata (IP, LastPage, CompleteSubmission, payment Status/PurchaseTotal/Currency/TransactionId/MerchantType).

tools.name: wufoo_list_form_entries
tools.title: List form entries
tools.description: List a form's submitted entries (as in the Entry Manager), keyed by field API ID (Field105…) plus EntryId, DateCreated, CreatedBy, DateUpdated, UpdatedBy. Filter like the Entry Manager (Filter1=Field105 Contains foo, combined with match AND/OR), sort by any field ID, and page with pageStart/pageSize (max 100). For entries keyed by human field titles use wufoo_get_labeled_entries. Wufoo: GET /forms/{identifier}/entries.json.

form.description: Form identifier: its permanent hash (e.g. s1afea8b1vk0jf7) or its URL title (e.g. wufoo-api-example). See wufoo_list_forms.

pageStart.description: Zero-based index of the first entry to return (default 0).

sort.description: Field API ID to sort by (e.g. EntryId, DateCreated, Field105).

sortDirection.description: ASC (default) or DESC. Only applies together with sort.

system.description: Include system metadata (IP, LastPage, CompleteSubmission, payment Status/PurchaseTotal/Currency/TransactionId/MerchantType).

filters.description: Entry Manager-style filters (up to 10), sent as Filter1, Filter2…

field.description: Field API ID to filter on (Field105, EntryId, DateCreated…). See wufoo_get_form_fields.

value.description: Value to compare with. Omit only for Is_not_NULL. Dates/times: "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS", read by Wufoo as US Pacific time.

match.description: Combine filters: AND (all must match, default) or OR (any).

tools.name: wufoo_get_labeled_entries
tools.title: Get entries keyed by field title
tools.description: Fetch a page of a form's entries with every Field### key replaced by the field's human title — e.g. "Email", or "Title — Label" for sub-fields of checkbox, name, address and likert fields ("Name — First", "Address — City"). EntryId, DateCreated and the other default/system keys stay as they are. Empty values are dropped unless includeEmpty is set. Also returns fieldIds (title → API ID) for building filters or submissions. Takes the same paging, sorting and filter arguments as wufoo_list_form_entries. Wufoo: GET /forms/{identifier}/fields.json + /entries.json.

tools.description: Count a form's entries — all of them, or only those matching filters (same filter format as wufoo_list_form_entries). Useful to plan paging. Returns {EntryCount}. Wufoo: GET /forms/{identifier}/entries/count.json.

tools.name: wufoo_list_form_comments
tools.title: List entry comments
tools.description: List the comments team members left on a form's entries in the Entry Manager: CommentId, EntryId, Text, CommentedBy, DateCreated. Optionally only for one entry. Page with pageStart/pageSize (max 100). Wufoo: GET /forms/{identifier}/comments.json.

form.description: Form identifier: its permanent hash (e.g. s1afea8b1vk0jf7) or its URL title (e.g. wufoo-api-example). See wufoo_list_forms.

pageStart.description: Zero-based index of the first comment (default 0).

tools.name: wufoo_count_form_comments
tools.title: Count entry comments
tools.description: Count all comments on a form's entries. Returns {Count}. Wufoo: GET /forms/{identifier}/comments/count.json.

form.description: Form identifier: its permanent hash (e.g. s1afea8b1vk0jf7) or its URL title (e.g. wufoo-api-example). See wufoo_list_forms.

tools.name: wufoo_list_reports
tools.title: List reports
tools.description: List the reports the API key's user can access: name, description, hash, URL title, public flag and created/updated timestamps. Wufoo: GET /reports.json.

tools.name: wufoo_get_report
tools.title: Get one report
tools.description: Fetch one report by hash or URL title. Wufoo: GET /reports/{identifier}.json.

report.description: Report identifier: its permanent hash (e.g. qa4d98l1ib9or7) or its URL title. See wufoo_list_reports.

tools.name: wufoo_get_report_fields

report.description: Report identifier: its permanent hash (e.g. qa4d98l1ib9or7) or its URL title. See wufoo_list_reports.

system.description: Include system metadata (IP, LastPage, CompleteSubmission, payment Status/PurchaseTotal/Currency/TransactionId/MerchantType).

tools.name: wufoo_list_report_entries
tools.title: List report entries
tools.description: The entries that make up a report — what its datagrid widget or an export would show, keyed by field API ID. Wufoo documents no paging or filter parameters for this endpoint. Wufoo: GET /reports/{identifier}/entries.json.

report.description: Report identifier: its permanent hash (e.g. qa4d98l1ib9or7) or its URL title. See wufoo_list_reports.

system.description: Include system metadata (IP, LastPage, CompleteSubmission, payment Status/PurchaseTotal/Currency/TransactionId/MerchantType).

tools.name: wufoo_count_report_entries
tools.title: Count report entries

report.description: Report identifier: its permanent hash (e.g. qa4d98l1ib9or7) or its URL title. See wufoo_list_reports.

tools.name: wufoo_list_report_widgets
tools.title: List report widgets
tools.description: The chart, graph (pie/bar/line) and big-number widgets on a report: Name, Type, TypeDesc, Size and Hash (the hash embeds the widget). Text and datagrid widgets are not returned. Wufoo: GET /reports/{identifier}/widgets.json.

report.description: Report identifier: its permanent hash (e.g. qa4d98l1ib9or7) or its URL title. See wufoo_list_reports.

tools.name: wufoo_list_users
tools.title: List account users
tools.description: List the account's users: name, email, timezone, company, owner/admin flags and create-forms/reports/themes permissions. Each user's API key is redacted from the result. Wufoo: GET /users.json.

tools.name: wufoo_submit_entry
tools.title: Submit a form entry
tools.description: WRITE: submits a new entry to a form, exactly as if someone filled it in — it is stored and triggers the form's notifications, webhooks and integrations. Keys are field API IDs from wufoo_get_form_fields (Field1, Field105…); fields with sub-fields (name, address, checkbox) take one key per sub-field ID. Dates must be YYYYMMDD. Field validation and form limits still apply: a rejected submission returns each field error. Limited by Wufoo to 50 submissions per user per 5 minutes. Wufoo: POST /forms/{identifier}/entries.json.

form.description: Form identifier: its permanent hash (e.g. s1afea8b1vk0jf7) or its URL title (e.g. wufoo-api-example). See wufoo_list_forms.

fields.description: Values keyed by field API ID, e.g. {"Field1": "Ada", "Field2": "Lovelace", "Field217": "20260315"}.

tools.name: wufoo_add_webhook
tools.title: Add a webhook
tools.description: WRITE: adds a webhook to a form, so Wufoo POSTs every new entry to the given URL. Idempotent per URL: calling again with the same URL updates its handshake key / metadata setting instead of adding a duplicate. Forms allow at most 10 integrations. Returns WebHookPutResult.Hash — keep it, it is needed to delete the webhook. Wufoo: PUT /forms/{identifier}/webhooks.json.

form.description: Form identifier: its permanent hash (e.g. s1afea8b1vk0jf7) or its URL title (e.g. wufoo-api-example). See wufoo_list_forms.

url.description: The URL Wufoo will POST each new entry to.

handshakeKey.description: Shared secret Wufoo includes in each POST so the receiver can reject unwanted requests.

metadata.description: Include form/field structure in each POST (Wufoo default false).

tools.name: wufoo_delete_webhook
tools.title: Delete a webhook
tools.description: WRITE: removes a webhook from a form; the receiving URL stops getting new entries immediately. Needs the webhook hash returned by wufoo_add_webhook (Wufoo has no endpoint to list webhooks). Wufoo: DELETE /forms/{identifier}/webhooks/{webhookHash}.json.

form.description: Form identifier: its permanent hash (e.g. s1afea8b1vk0jf7) or its URL title (e.g. wufoo-api-example). See wufoo_list_forms.
